title: spec docs: permission.zod.ts says the built-in admin permission sets grant export, but default-permission-sets withholds it — admin gets 403 EXPORT_NOT_PERMITTED and no Export control
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect, reproduced, landing site named.
Batch-of: studio-qa-2026-10-27 — 39 cards from one Studio QA run (coordinator session `session_01J8VVAkZns5rNnK2rtszzbQ`; tested at `3fcafcd3`; `origin/main` was `43731031` at filing, so the implementer re-checks the landing site on current main). The run record is the `qa-run` issue filed with this batch.

## Symptom

The describe text and the shipped default disagree, so an admin reading the docs expects to export and cannot.

## Reproduction

1. As the seeded admin, open any list → no Export control; `GET /api/v1/data/<obj>/export` (or the export door) → 403 EXPORT_NOT_PERMITTED.
2. Compare `packages/spec/src/security/permission.zod.ts` (~lines 500-501, allowExport describe) with `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/default-permission-sets.ts` (~line 338, admin_full_access has no export).

## Expected

Docs and default agree (protocol first: change whichever is not the decided behaviour; this card only reports the contradiction).

## Suspected landing site (the implementer verifies)

`packages/spec/src/security/permission.zod.ts` describe text (or the default set, if the docs are the decision).

## Filing facts

- reach: HTTP + source read, measured by the view gap-fill card.
- Business reason: Admins and AI authors are told export is on by default for admins; it is not.
- Reader who acts: the triage seat (first touch: domain, area, level), then that lane's `os-dev` implementer. QA suggestion only: `domain:spec`, `area:access`, p3.
- Dedupe: semantic search `admin permission set grants export docs but EXPORT_NOT_PERMITTED allowExport withheld` on objectstack-ai/objectstack → 9 hits, none about this docs/default contradiction (nearest closed #18931).
- QA id: S6
